articles.summary: Poor sleep is rarely caused by just one thing, yet most sleep solutions aim to ameliorate only one problem. For example, a cooling mattress pad addresses overnight heat.
articles.title: Nighttime temperature to daytime function: Sleep improvements with the Pod

articles.summary: Contributed by Eight Sleep Clinical Team The Eight Sleep Pod is a temperature-enabled sleep tracker. Throughout the night, the Pod makes real-time temperature adjustments (warming or cooling) based on you and your sleep.
articles.title: Sleep improvements that actually last: how the Pod outperforms sleep trackers
